description: A freely available PC, smartphone, and tablet serious game developed by Klein et al.
title: Vector Field Game

description: VEGA is a generative-AI nursing education agent built on the CAFA platform that generates NCJMM-aligned vignette-based item sets and provides immediate explanatory feedback to learners.
title: VEGA

description: VentSim is free interactive online software developed by the authors for simulating mechanical-ventilation modes, patient–ventilator interaction, and ventilator waveforms in medical training.
title: VentSim

description: A publicly available online ecological modeling tool hosted through the Smithsonian's Encyclopedia of Life that supports conceptual modeling, agent-based simulation, hypothesis-driven experimentation, and model–simulate–refine activities.
title: VERA (Virtual Experimentation Research Assistant) ecological modeling tool

description: An online, interviewer-administered situational judgment assessment developed by the study authors to evaluate ophthalmology fellowship applicants' communication, collaboration, critical thinking, curiosity, creativity, and interview preparedness through rubric-scored verbal responses.
title: Verbal construct-driven SJT with 5Cs rubric and real-time scoring

description: A dataset of teacher-verified mathematics and English/language arts subject and student links used to assess the accuracy of administrative teacher–student linkage data and examine departmentalization.
title: Verified teacher-subject-student link data

description: VeriForge is a mixed-initiative writing environment developed by Ruqi Sun et al.
title: VeriForge

description: A Verizon and Digital Promise programme that equips Title I middle and high schools with devices, connectivity, digital-skills training, STEM curriculum, and dedicated learning-coach support.
title: Verizon Innovative Learning Schools

description: Versius Trainer is CMR Surgical’s virtual simulation software for training and assessing robotic-console skills through proficiency-based surgical tasks and performance metrics.
title: Versius Trainer

description: Veterans on Campus is Kognito's online game-based role-play simulation that trains higher-education faculty, staff, and administrators to understand student veterans' experiences, conduct sensitive conversations, and connect distressed veterans with support services.
title: Veterans on Campus (VOC)

description: A VEX-supported 10-week educational robotics programme in which secondary students build and program robots while applying Mathematics and Science concepts through hands-on problems and customised worksheets.
title: VEX Robotics education programme
